Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Quality built barbecue with many extras. Wish both side trays folded down as unit takes up a lot of space when not being used. Also the left tray must be used for moving the unit and the folding mechanism sometimes comes unlocks while moving causing tray stability problems.
Results.Title: Great Barbecue

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After many grills the Weber Sprite II is the best yet for a small family. Dependable and very handsome!
Results.Title: Best Grrill Ever!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Fits in well in my small patio.  Cooking surface is robust for a smaller grill.
Pleased to report that the grill was able to handle 6 large steaks delivering a great sear with ideal internal temperature.
Seams stingy on the propane consumption as well.
Spirit ll a must for all!,
Results.Title: Good value with no cooking compromise.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Used it twice so far and had great results both times. You do can a lot of heat roll out the front when you raise the lid, but it is a grill.
Results.Title: Cook's Great !

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought it about 2 months ago.  Very easy to assemble.  Perfect size for my wife and I and small parties.  Now all she has to do is learn how to grill so I can play with my truck... LOL
Results.Title: Perfect grill for us

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
